question: Should memory-lancedb publicly support all three proposed auto-recall knobs, including the implementation-level autoRecallOverfetch setting?
rationale: The repository deliberately limits new config surface, and source inspection can verify implementation correctness but cannot decide which retrieval internals should become permanent supported operator contracts.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Expose the similarity threshold and result cap, keep overfetch internal, and require aligned schema/tests plus live proof.

options.title: Approve all three knobs
options.body: Accept all three as supported plugin config after the integer schema mismatch is fixed and a real auto-recall run is demonstrated.

options.title: Keep fixed defaults
options.body: Decline the configuration expansion and retain the existing internal constants until stronger operator demand is documented.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public surface
recommendation.body: Expose the similarity threshold and result cap, keep overfetch internal, and require aligned schema/tests plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-lancedb history and prior memory-plugin product reviews make this the strongest available routing candidate for config-surface direction.
